description.value: Waterfront Wines Restaurant is a multiple-award-winning fine dining destination on Kelowna's Okanagan Lake waterfront, recognized as the 'Best Okanagan Restaurant' by Vancouver Magazine twelve consecutive years running. Chef-Sommelier Mark Filatow builds seasonal menus around a curated network of Okanagan producers — Ocean Wise seafood, heritage proteins, foraged mushrooms, and organic produce — paired with a cellar of over 300 local and international wines. A touring cyclist looking for a celebratory dinner will find inventive, ingredient-driven plates in an approachable waterfront setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at waterfrontrestaurant.ca is fully operational and confirms the OSM address with an added unit number (#104 – 1180 Sunset Drive, Kelowna, BC, V1Y 9W6) and supplies a phone number (250.979.1222) absent from OSM tags. The contact page explicitly states 'Take Out Available via phone,' and the dinner menu labels one entrée 'Vegan Beluga Lentil Cakes' (explicitly vegan) alongside other vegetarian-compatible starters. No mention of bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM tags contain no phone number; website lists 250.979.1222.
OSM address omits unit number; full address is #104 – 1180 Sunset Drive.
Liquor-primary licence requires all guests to be 19 or older; families cycling with minors cannot be accommodated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, award-winning restaurant at a prominent Kelowna waterfront location; a legitimate and notable dining destination that touring cyclists seeking an evening meal would value.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists 'Vegan Beluga Lentil Cakes' as a main course; multiple starters (hummus, asparagus salad, burrata) are vegetarian-compatible
